boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Point Loma Nazarene University
boards.description: Ten named, under-21-safe food destinations with directly verified late hours for a Point Loma-area night out.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 1340 Rosecrans St
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Rosecrans
cards.subtitle: 1340 Rosecrans St, San Diego
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a later option near Point Loma. Check the location page before leaving, since posted hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A Point Loma-side drive-thru with service listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists the drive-thru as open daily until 4:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1340 Rosecrans St, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours through 4:00 a.m. daily; lobby hours are listed separately through 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: In-N-Out at Sports Arena
cards.subtitle: 3102 Sports Arena Blvd., San Diego
cards.notes: Plan around the stated closing time and use the restaurant’s directions for the Sports Arena and Rosecrans location before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A nearby burger counter open until 1 a.m., with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out lists this Sports Arena Boulevard restaurant as open until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 3102 Sports Arena Blvd., San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours: 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Midway
cards.subtitle: 3152 Midway Drive, San Diego
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru-focused late option on Midway. Confirm the day’s schedule and choose the drive-thru after dine-in service has ended.
cards.short_summary: A Midway Drive option with drive-thru hours extending after midnight most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists drive-thru closing times of 1:45 a.m. on several nights and 2:45 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3152 Midway Drive, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours run to 1:45 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 2:45 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; Sunday is listed to 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Midway
cards.subtitle: 3760 Midway Drive, San Diego
cards.notes: Use this Midway location for a late food stop, with the restaurant or drive-thru schedule checked against the official location page before travel.
cards.short_summary: A Midway Drive restaurant listed through midnight daily and 1 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight Monday through Thursday and until 1:00 a.m. Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours: through 12:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and through 1:00 a.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 3838 Midway Dr
cards.title: Jack in the Box at 3838 Midway
cards.subtitle: 3838 Midway Dr, San Diego
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru stop after the lobby closes. The official page distinguishes drive-thru and lobby availability, so use the right service mode.
cards.short_summary: A Midway Drive drive-thru whose official listing runs until 3:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists the drive-thru at 3838 Midway Drive as open until 3:30 a.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 3838 Midway Dr, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 3:30 a.m.; the lobby is listed until 10:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 4815 Voltaire St
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Voltaire
cards.subtitle: 4815 Voltaire St, San Diego
cards.notes: Use the official hours page to confirm availability before making the Ocean Beach-side trip; both lobby and drive-thru are currently listed late.
cards.short_summary: A Voltaire Street location whose listed lobby and drive-thru hours run through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists both the lobby and drive-thru as open daily until 4:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 4815 Voltaire St, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby and drive-thru hours through 4:00 a.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 1905 Garnet Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Garnet
cards.subtitle: 1905 Garnet Ave, San Diego
cards.notes: For a Pacific Beach-side late stop, rely on the drive-thru schedule rather than assuming lobby access; confirm the posted hours the day you go.
cards.short_summary: A Garnet Avenue drive-thru listed until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists the drive-thru at 1905 Garnet Avenue as open daily until 4:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1905 Garnet Ave, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours through 4:00 a.m. daily; it presents lobby hours separately.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4401 Mission Blvd., San Diego
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service if arriving after the dining room closes. The official location page provides separate late-hour schedules by day.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard drive-thru with the latest listed closing times on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and until 4:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 4401 Mission Blvd., San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours are listed through 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Grand Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1621 Grand Avenue, San Diego
cards.notes: Use this Pacific Beach location when a restaurant or drive-thru option through midnight fits the plan; recheck the official listing for holiday changes.
cards.short_summary: A Grand Avenue restaurant listed until midnight, with 1 a.m. hours Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight most days and until 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours run through 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and through 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Camino Del Este
cards.subtitle: 2011 Camino Del Este, San Diego
cards.notes: For a Mission Valley-side late option, use the drive-thru schedule on the official page and account for the dining room’s earlier closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Camino Del Este drive-thru listed to 1 a.m. most nights and later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists drive-thru hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2011 Camino Del Este, San Diego
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours run through 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in availability is separate.
